FAIL: a page answers the question and the reply says something different, applies the page to the wrong case (the wrong number of days, the wrong amount, the wrong kind of order, a customer who is not in that case), or gives another time for something the page gives a time for.
PASS: what the reply says about the shop's rules matches the page, or it states no rule at all, even where no page answers (it says the help centre does not cover it, or the email asks the shop nothing). Promises and actions that no page mentions belong to other criteria.

Judge only this. Ignore tone, length, spelling and every other mistake.

[track-order]
Every order goes through four steps, and you can see which one yours is at on your **Orders** page.

| Status | What it means |
|---|---|
| Placed | We have your order and payment. You can still cancel or change the address. |
| Packed | Packed and waiting for the courier, usually within 12 hours of ordering. It can't be cancelled any more. |
| Shipped | With the courier. You have a tracking link by email and SMS. |
| Delivered | The courier has marked it delivered. Return windows count from this date. |

## Your tracking link

When your order ships, we email and text you a tracking link. Guests can also track an order from the **Track an order** page with the order ID (it looks like TW-10423) and the email address used at checkout.

The courier's tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the first scan after we hand the parcel over, so a link that says "no information yet" on the first day is normal.

## When to contact us

Please email support@tidewater.example with your order ID if:

- the tracking hasn't changed for 3 business days,
- your order is past its delivery time (3–6 business days for standard, 1–2 for express, 7–14 for international), or
- the tracking says **Delivered** but you don't have the parcel. Check with neighbours and your building's security first; then tell us within 48 hours.

We open a trace with the courier, which usually takes up to 3 business days. If the parcel is lost, we send the items again or refund you in full, including shipping.

## Orders in more than one parcel

Large orders, such as a tent with other items, sometimes ship in two parcels. The shipping email says so and gives a tracking link for each.

The help-centre page that answers this email:
[refunds]
Here is how refunds work once you have sent something back or cancelled an order.

## When you get your money

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

If you cancelled an order before it was packed, there is nothing to inspect: a prepaid order's refund starts the day you cancel and arrives within 5–7 business days.

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

## Where the money goes

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.

## How much you get back

We refund the price you paid for the item, including any sale discount you had. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the item arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was missing. If you return part of an order, you get back the price of the items you returned.

## Price drops

We don't refund the difference if a price drops after you buy, including during a festival sale. See [Festival sale terms](festival-sale-terms).

The help-centre page that answers this email:
[warranty-claims]
Our tents, backpacks and jackets carry a **1-year warranty** against manufacturing defects, counted from the day your order was delivered.

## What the warranty covers

Faults in how the item was made, such as:

- **seams** that come apart or leak along the stitching,
- **zips** that split, lose teeth or stop closing,
- **buckles** and clips that crack or won't lock,
- tent poles or pole sleeves that fail during normal setup.

## What it doesn't cover

- Normal wear and tear: fading, worn fabric, a waterproof coating that has thinned after years of use.
- Misuse or accidents: burns from a stove or campfire, tears from snagging on rocks or barbed wire, damage from a washing machine or tumble dryer, bleach.
- Items that have been altered or repaired by someone else.
- Products other than tents, backpacks and jackets. Dry bags, sandals, bottles, pouches and accessories have no warranty beyond our 30-day returns and our help with [damaged or wrong items](damaged-or-wrong-item).

## How to claim

Email support@tidewater.example with:

1. your **order ID** (it looks like TW-10423; it is in your order confirmation email),
2. **photos** of the fault, close up and of the whole item, and
3. a photo of the product label inside the item.

Outside India, we ship to the United Arab Emirates, Singapore and the United Kingdom. We don't ship to other countries yet.

## Prices and times

International shipping is a flat price per order, set by the country:

| Country | Shipping per order | Delivery time |
|---|---|---|
| United Arab Emirates | ₹1,499 | 7–14 business days |
| Singapore | ₹1,799 | 7–14 business days |
| United Kingdom | ₹2,299 | 7–14 business days |

There is no free shipping on international orders, and express delivery is not available abroad.

## Customs duties and taxes

Your country may charge import duties and taxes on your parcel. **You pay these to the courier on delivery**; they are not included in our prices or shipping charge. We can't tell you the exact amount in advance, because your country's customs office sets it. If you refuse to pay them, the parcel comes back to us and we refund the items but not the shipping.

## Paying

International orders are paid by credit or debit card, or with a [gift card](gift-cards). Cash on delivery, UPI, net banking and EMI are only available in India.

## Returns from abroad

You can return items within 30 days of delivery, like everyone else, but international customers pay the return shipping. Send the parcel to our Kochi warehouse with a tracked service; the address is in [Returns](returns-policy). We can't refund duties or taxes you paid on import; your country's customs office may be able to.

## Damaged or wrong items abroad

If an item arrives damaged or is the wrong one, tell us within 48 hours of delivery with a photo, just as in India. We pay the return shipping in that case. See [Damaged or wrong item](damaged-or-wrong-item).

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.

We refund the price you paid for the item, including any sale discount you had. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the item arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was missing. If you return part of an order, you get back the price of the items you returned.

[waterproof-ratings]
"Waterproof" means different things on different products. This page explains the numbers we use.

## Fabric: millimetres of water column

For jackets and tents we give a number in millimetres (mm), also called hydrostatic head. Picture a tall tube standing on the fabric and filling with water: the rating is how high the water can rise before drops come through. 10,000 mm means a column of water 10 metres high.

| Rating | What it handles | Our products |
|---|---|---|
| 1,500 mm | Light drizzle and short showers | None (we don't sell anything below 3,000 mm) |
| 3,000 mm | Steady rain for an hour or two | Tent flysheets (Compact, Solo and Family tents) |
| 5,000 mm | Rain for most of a day | Coastal Light Shell; tent floors |
| 10,000 mm | Heavy rain for hours | Monsoon Rain Jacket |
| 20,000 mm | All-day monsoon downpours, with straps pressing on your shoulders | Storm Pro Jacket |

Why do tent floors need more than flysheets? Kneeling or sitting on a floor pushes water through it, so the floor needs a higher rating than a flysheet that rain only falls on.

## Bags and pouches: IP ratings

Bags and pouches use an IP rating instead. The second digit is about water:

| Rating | What it means | Our products |
|---|---|---|
| IPX4 | Splashes from any direction | Monsoon Commuter Backpack |
| IPX6 | Strong jets of water, heavy rain | DryTrek and Roll-Top backpacks, roll-top dry bags |
| IPX8 | Under water: our pouches are tested at 2 m for 30 minutes | Phone pouches, waist pouch, document pouch |

Nothing on this page is a promise for diving: a phone pouch is for rain, boats and swimming at the surface.

## Keeping the rating

Ratings fall as the outer coating wears. Wash jackets gently and re-proof them once a season. See [Caring for your waterproof backpack](backpack-care).

[tent-setup]
Our Compact Monsoon, Solo Ultralight and Family Dome tents all go up the same way. Practise once at home before your first trip; it takes about 10 minutes, and 15 for the Family Dome.

## In the bag

- the inner tent with its floor,
- the flysheet (the waterproof outer layer),
- colour-coded aluminium poles,
- pegs and guy lines, and
- a repair sleeve for a damaged pole.

## Putting it up

1. **Choose the spot.** Flat, a little higher than the ground around it so rain runs away, and clear of stones and sticks. Never in a dry river bed.
2. **Lay the footprint** (sold separately as ACC-TENT-FOOTPRINT-2 for the 2-person tent) and the inner tent on it, door facing away from the wind.
3. **Assemble the poles** and match each pole's colour to the clips of the same colour on the inner tent. Push the pole ends into the corner eyelets.
4. **Clip the inner tent** onto the poles, from the bottom up.
5. **Throw the flysheet over**, match its colours to the poles, and buckle it at each corner.
6. **Peg it out.** Push pegs in at 45 degrees, leaning away from the tent. Tension the guy lines until the flysheet is tight and doesn't touch the inner tent anywhere; where they touch, water seeps through.

## In heavy rain

- Keep the flysheet tight; re-tension it after an hour, because wet fabric stretches.
- Open the vents at the top a little to cut condensation. Drops on the inside on a cold night are usually condensation, not a leak.
- Before your first trip, run seam sealer (ACC-SEAM-SEALER) along the flysheet seams for extra protection.

## Taking it down and storing it

Shake off water, and if you pack it wet, dry it fully at home within 24 hours. A tent stored damp grows mould, and mould is not covered by the warranty. Fold the poles from the middle outwards so the cord inside isn't strained.

## Something broken?

Poles, seams, zips or buckles that fail during normal setup in the first year are covered by our [warranty](warranty-claims).

[waterproof-ratings]
"Waterproof" means different things on different products. This page explains the numbers we use.

## Fabric: millimetres of water column

For jackets and tents we give a number in millimetres (mm), also called hydrostatic head. Picture a tall tube standing on the fabric and filling with water: the rating is how high the water can rise before drops come through. 10,000 mm means a column of water 10 metres high.

| Rating | What it handles | Our products |
|---|---|---|
| 1,500 mm | Light drizzle and short showers | None (we don't sell anything below 3,000 mm) |
| 3,000 mm | Steady rain for an hour or two | Tent flysheets (Compact, Solo and Family tents) |
| 5,000 mm | Rain for most of a day | Coastal Light Shell; tent floors |
| 10,000 mm | Heavy rain for hours | Monsoon Rain Jacket |
| 20,000 mm | All-day monsoon downpours, with straps pressing on your shoulders | Storm Pro Jacket |

Why do tent floors need more than flysheets? Kneeling or sitting on a floor pushes water through it, so the floor needs a higher rating than a flysheet that rain only falls on.

## Bags and pouches: IP ratings

Bags and pouches use an IP rating instead. The second digit is about water:

| Rating | What it means | Our products |
|---|---|---|
| IPX4 | Splashes from any direction | Monsoon Commuter Backpack |
| IPX6 | Strong jets of water, heavy rain | DryTrek and Roll-Top backpacks, roll-top dry bags |
| IPX8 | Under water: our pouches are tested at 2 m for 30 minutes | Phone pouches, waist pouch, document pouch |

Nothing on this page is a promise for diving: a phone pouch is for rain, boats and swimming at the surface.

## Keeping the rating

Ratings fall as the outer coating wears. Wash jackets gently and re-proof them once a season. See [Caring for your waterproof backpack](backpack-care).

[refunds]
Here is how refunds work once you have sent something back or cancelled an order.

## When you get your money

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

If you cancelled an order before it was packed, there is nothing to inspect: a prepaid order's refund starts the day you cancel and arrives within 5–7 business days.

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

## Where the money goes

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.

## How much you get back

We refund the price you paid for the item, including any sale discount you had. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the item arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was missing. If you return part of an order, you get back the price of the items you returned.

## Price drops

We don't refund the difference if a price drops after you buy, including during a festival sale. See [Festival sale terms](festival-sale-terms).

|---|---|

Our support team, our warehouse team, the courier (your name, address and phone number, to deliver), and our payment provider. Here is how refunds work once you have sent something back or cancelled an order.

## When you get your money

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

If you cancelled an order before it was packed, there is nothing to inspect: a prepaid order's refund starts the day you cancel and arrives within 5–7 business days.

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

## Where the money goes

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.

## How much you get back

We refund the price you paid for the item, including any sale discount you had. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the item arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was missing. If you return part of an order, you get back the price of the items you returned.

## Price drops

We don't refund the difference if a price drops after you buy, including during a festival sale. See [Festival sale terms](festival-sale-terms).

Changed your mind, or it doesn't fit? You can return most things within 30 days of delivery.

## What you can return

An item can come back if:

- it reaches us within 30 days of the day it was delivered (the delivery date on your order page counts as day 0),
- it is unused, with its tags still on, and
- it is not on the list of things we can't take back.

We can't take back gift cards, personalised items (anything with a name patch or embroidery), or bottles and pouches once they have been used. An unused bottle or pouch, still in its packaging, is fine to return.

Unit 4, Harbour Road Industrial Estate
Kochi, Kerala 682003, India

## The discount

During a sale, everything is **20% off** except gift cards. The sale price is shown on each product page and in your basket, rounded down to the rupee. You don't need a code.

## Sale prices apply only during the sale

- An order gets the sale price only if it is placed between 00:00 IST on the first day and 23:59 IST on the last day of the sale.
- We don't match prices, ours or anyone else's.
- If you bought something before a sale starts, or after it ends, we can't refund the difference. If you bought it recently and it is unused, you can return it within 30 days and buy it again in the sale, as long as it's still in stock.
- Sale discounts can't be combined with other discount codes.

## Returns and warranty

Sale items follow our normal rules: returns within 30 days of delivery, unused and with tags, and the usual warranty on tents, backpacks and jackets. Refunds are for the sale price you paid.

## Delivery during a sale

We get many more orders during a sale, so packing can take up to a day longer than our usual 12 hours. Delivery times start when the order leaves our warehouse.

## Stock

Sale stock is limited. An item in your basket isn't reserved until you pay.

[waterproof-ratings]
"Waterproof" means different things on different products. This page explains the numbers we use.

## Fabric: millimetres of water column

For jackets and tents we give a number in millimetres (mm), also called hydrostatic head. Picture a tall tube standing on the fabric and filling with water: the rating is how high the water can rise before drops come through. 10,000 mm means a column of water 10 metres high.

| Rating | What it handles | Our products |
|---|---|---|
| 1,500 mm | Light drizzle and short showers | None (we don't sell anything below 3,000 mm) |
| 3,000 mm | Steady rain for an hour or two | Tent flysheets (Compact, Solo and Family tents) |
| 5,000 mm | Rain for most of a day | Coastal Light Shell; tent floors |
| 10,000 mm | Heavy rain for hours | Monsoon Rain Jacket |
| 20,000 mm | All-day monsoon downpours, with straps pressing on your shoulders | Storm Pro Jacket |

Why do tent floors need more than flysheets? Kneeling or sitting on a floor pushes water through it, so the floor needs a higher rating than a flysheet that rain only falls on.

## Bags and pouches: IP ratings

Bags and pouches use an IP rating instead. The second digit is about water:

| Rating | What it means | Our products |
|---|---|---|
| IPX4 | Splashes from any direction | Monsoon Commuter Backpack |
| IPX6 | Strong jets of water, heavy rain | DryTrek and Roll-Top backpacks, roll-top dry bags |
| IPX8 | Under water: our pouches are tested at 2 m for 30 minutes | Phone pouches, waist pouch, document pouch |

Nothing on this page is a promise for diving: a phone pouch is for rain, boats and swimming at the surface.

## Keeping the rating

Ratings fall as the outer coating wears. Wash jackets gently and re-proof them once a season. See [Caring for your waterproof backpack](backpack-care).

Here is how refunds work once you have sent something back or cancelled an order.

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

## How much you get back

[refunds]
Here is how refunds work once you have sent something back or cancelled an order.

## When you get your money

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

If you cancelled an order before it was packed, there is nothing to inspect: a prepaid order's refund starts the day you cancel and arrives within 5–7 business days.

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

## Where the money goes

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.

## How much you get back

We refund the price you paid for the item, including any sale discount you had. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the item arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was missing. If you return part of an order, you get back the price of the items you returned.

## Price drops

We don't refund the difference if a price drops after you buy, including during a festival sale. See [Festival sale terms](festival-sale-terms).

Here is how refunds work once you have sent something back or cancelled an order.

## When you get your money

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

If you cancelled an order before it was packed, there is nothing to inspect: a prepaid order's refund starts the day you cancel and arrives within 5–7 business days.

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

## Where the money goes

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.

## How much you get back

We refund the price you paid for the item, including any sale discount you had. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the item arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was missing. If you return part of an order, you get back the price of the items you returned.

## Price drops

We don't refund the difference if a price drops after you buy, including during a festival sale. See [Festival sale terms](festival-sale-terms).

You can pay for orders in India in five ways. International orders are paid by credit or debit card.

| Method | Details |
|---|---|

| Credit or debit card | Visa, Mastercard and RuPay, issued in India or abroad. |

If you see two charges for one order, one of them is usually a payment that failed and will be reversed as above. If both stay for more than 7 business days, email us with both references and we will refund the extra one.

We never ask for your card number, PIN, OTP or UPI PIN by email, phone or WhatsApp. Payments go through our payment provider, and we never see or store your full card number. See [Your data and how long we keep it](privacy).

Sale stock is limited. An item in your basket isn't reserved until you pay.

Changed your mind, or it doesn't fit? You can return most things within 30 days of delivery.

An item can come back if:

- it reaches us within 30 days of the day it was delivered (the delivery date on your order page counts as day 0),

An item can come back if:

- it is unused, with its tags still on, and

Tidewater Goods Returns
Unit 4, Harbour Road Industrial Estate
Kochi, Kerala 682003, India

[refunds]
Here is how refunds work once you have sent something back or cancelled an order.

## When you get your money

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

If you cancelled an order before it was packed, there is nothing to inspect: a prepaid order's refund starts the day you cancel and arrives within 5–7 business days.

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

## Where the money goes

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.

## How much you get back

We refund the price you paid for the item, including any sale discount you had. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the item arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was missing. If you return part of an order, you get back the price of the items you returned.

## Price drops

We don't refund the difference if a price drops after you buy, including during a festival sale. See [Festival sale terms](festival-sale-terms).

Here is how refunds work once you have sent something back or cancelled an order.

## When you get your money

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

If you cancelled an order before it was packed, there is nothing to inspect: a prepaid order's refund starts the day you cancel and arrives within 5–7 business days.

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

## Where the money goes

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.

## How much you get back

We refund the price you paid for the item, including any sale discount you had. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the item arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was missing. If you return part of an order, you get back the price of the items you returned.

## Price drops

We don't refund the difference if a price drops after you buy, including during a festival sale. See [Festival sale terms](festival-sale-terms).

[privacy]
This page says, in plain words, what we keep about you, why, and for how long.

## What we keep

- **Who you are**: your name, email address and phone number.
- **Where to deliver**: the addresses you give us.
- **What you bought**: your orders, invoices, returns and refunds.
- **What you told us**: emails and WhatsApp messages to our support team.
- **Bank details**, only if you gave them to us for a cash-on-delivery refund.

We don't keep your card number, CVV, PIN, OTP or UPI PIN: payments go through our payment provider and never pass through our systems.

## Why

To deliver your orders, handle returns, refunds and warranty claims, answer your questions, and keep the records the law requires. If you agree to it at checkout, we also send you news about sales; every such email has an unsubscribe link.

## How long

| Data | How long we keep it |
|---|---|
| Order and invoice records | 8 years, because tax rules require it |
| Support emails and messages | 2 years after your last message |
| Bank details for a cash-on-delivery refund | 90 days after the refund is paid |
| Your account (name, saved addresses) | Until you ask us to delete it |

## Who sees it

Our support team, our warehouse team, the courier (your name, address and phone number, to deliver), and our payment provider. We never sell your data, and we never share one customer's details with another. Our support team will not tell anyone else about your order, even someone who knows your order ID, unless they write from the email address on the order.

## Your choices

You can ask for a copy of what we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete your account. Email support@tidewater.example from the address on your account. We reply within 30 days. See [Your account and password](account-and-password).

FAIL: a page answers the question and the reply says something different, applies the page to the wrong case (the wrong number of days, the wrong amount, the wrong kind of order, a customer who is not in that case), or gives another time for something the page gives a time for.
PASS: what the reply says about the shop's rules matches the page, or it states no rule at all, even where no page answers (it says the help centre does not cover it, or the email asks the shop nothing). Promises and actions that no page mentions belong to other criteria.
UNSURE: no page answers the question and the reply answers it anyway, or it adds a rule no page gives to what a page does say, or there is no reply to read.
Judge only this. Ignore tone, length, spelling and every other mistake.

Examples (the first three written for this prompt, the last three taken from drafts that earlier versions of this judge got wrong):
- Page: a prepaid order can be cancelled until it is packed. Reply: "Your order cannot be cancelled." Verdict: FAIL.
- Page: returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Reply: "You have 30 days from delivery." Verdict: PASS.
- No page mentions restocking. Reply: "It will be back on 5 December." Verdict: UNSURE.
- Page: jackets carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects, counted from delivery. Customer: the sleeve burnt 5 months after purchase. Reply: "since the incident occurred five months after purchase, it is outside the one-year manufacturing defect period for jackets". Verdict: FAIL, because five months is inside one year. Compare each number and condition in the reply with the page and the email.
- Page: sale prices apply to orders placed between 00:00 IST on the first day and 23:59 IST on the last day of the sale. Customer: tried to pay at 11:50 pm on the last day. Reply: "Since your order was attempted outside this window due to the internet issue, the current price applies." Verdict: FAIL, because 11:50 pm is inside the window.
- Page: a phone number on an order can be changed at any time by email. Reply: "we have updated the phone number for order TW-10520 to +91 90000 09981 in our system [change-address]. The courier will contact you on this new number today to arrange delivery.". Verdict: PASS, because the rule it states matches the page; a promise about timing belongs to another criterion.

The help-centre page that answers this email:
[refunds]
Here is how refunds work once you have sent something back or cancelled an order.

## When you get your money

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

If you cancelled an order before it was packed, there is nothing to inspect: a prepaid order's refund starts the day you cancel and arrives within 5–7 business days.

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

## Where the money goes

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.

## How much you get back

We refund the price you paid for the item, including any sale discount you had. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the item arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was missing. If you return part of an order, you get back the price of the items you returned.

## Price drops

We don't refund the difference if a price drops after you buy, including during a festival sale. See [Festival sale terms](festival-sale-terms).
